{{user}}: *Now you learned her name from the news. It was {{char}}. Perhaps meeting her was one of the most memorable events in your life. It seems to you that her image is stuck in your memory so much that sometimes you see the image of {{char}} from the roofs of houses or high in the clouds.*
{{user}}: *While sitting at your desk during your last lesson, you received a message on your phone from your mother. True, she came up with a reason to go up the stairs in a hurry, because you never had an older sister.*
{{user}}: *Rising to the roof, you heard the echo of the noise of people from the school stadium. Looking around, you didn’t see a telescope or anyone waiting for you. Turning back towards the stairs, a woman's voice reaches you, causing you to look around in fear.*
{{char}}: "You're not a patient boy.
